articles.title: Greetings from a surreal expanse of sand dunes dotted with freshwater lagoons in Brazil
articles.summary: 巴西东北部的 Lençóis Maranhenses 国家公园有白沙丘与雨后形成的无数淡水泻湖，宛如外星地貌，是徒步与戏水的绝佳去处。

sentences.en: Earlier this summer, on a trip to northeastern Brazil, I visited somewhere unlike anywhere I've been before.
sentences.zh: 今年初夏，在去巴西北部旅行的途中，我探访了一个与我此前到过的任何地方都不同的所在。

sentences.en: A four-hour bus ride from the steamy tropical city of São Luis took me to Barreirinhas, a sleepy fishing town.
sentences.zh: 从闷热的热带城市圣路易斯出发，四个小时的大巴车程把我带到了巴雷里尼亚斯——一座宁静的渔村。

sentences.en: From there, I took a very bumpy ride on a 4x4 to reach the pristine white sand dunes of the National Park of Lençóis Maranhenses.
sentences.zh: 从那里，我乘坐一辆颠簸的越野车，抵达了 Lençóis Maranhenses 国家公园纯净的白沙丘。

sentences.en: This unique landscape of hundreds of thousands of acres of sand is bordered by thick jungle on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other.
sentences.zh: 这片由数十万英亩沙地构成的独特地貌，一侧是茂密丛林，另一侧是大西洋。

sentences.en: The park gets its name "Lençóis" from the Portuguese for "bedsheets," as the dunes look like billowing sheets when viewed from above.
sentences.zh: 公园的名字“Lençóis”来自葡萄牙语的“床单”，因为从高处俯瞰，沙丘就像起伏的床单。

sentences.en: Climbing to the top of the dunes was no mean feat for my unaccustomed feet, which sank deeper into the powder-fine sand with each step.
sentences.zh: 对我这双不习惯走沙地的脚来说，爬上沙丘顶绝非易事，每走一步，脚都会更深地陷进细如粉末的沙里。

sentences.en: When I visited in July, more than 35,000 lagoons that punctuate the seemingly endless stretch of dunes had filled with freshwater after the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 我七月到访时，点缀在无尽沙丘间的三万五千多个泻湖，在雨季过后蓄满了淡水。

sentences.en: The reward was views that looked like something out of a sci-fi film.
sentences.zh: 回报是宛如科幻电影画面的景致。

sentences.en: In fact, this isn't a desert at all — it gets about 50 inches of rainfall a year, more than double what falls in London.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这根本不是沙漠——它每年降雨量约 50 英寸，是伦敦的两倍多。

sentences.en: Looking out at what appeared to be a vast white desert interrupted by glittering blue pools felt like being on another planet.
sentences.zh: 眺望这片看似广阔白色荒漠、又被闪烁蓝池点缀的景象，感觉像身处另一个星球。

grammar: 不定代词 + 省略关系词定语从句：somewhere unlike anywhere I've been before 中，anywhere 后接省略 that 的定语从句 I've been before。
介词短语作地点状语：From there / A four-hour bus ride from the steamy tropical city 用 from 引出起点，丰富方位表达。
非限制性定语从句：which sank deeper into the powder-fine sand with each step 中 which 指代 my unaccustomed feet，补充细节。
现在分词作后置定语：more than 35,000 lagoons that punctuate the seemingly endless stretch of dunes 中 punctuate 现在分词表主动“点缀”。
动名词作主语：Climbing to the top of the dunes was no mean feat 中 Climbing 动名词短语作主语，feat 意为“难事/成就”。
比较级 more than double：more than double what falls in London 表示“是伦敦降雨量的两倍多”。
感官系动词 + like：felt like being on another planet 中 feel like 后接动名词，表示“感觉像是……”。

articles.title: AI chatbots are offering financial advice. Should you trust them?
articles.summary: 越来越多美国人用 AI 聊天机器人管理财务，研究显示它能给出不错的广谱建议，但在复杂情形下可能自信地出错，专家提醒勿盲从。

sentences.en: Experts say AI can get personal finance fundamentals right but may struggle with nuanced questions.
sentences.zh: 专家说，AI 能正确处理个人理财的基本问题，但在微妙复杂的问题上可能力不从心。

sentences.en: The data analytics company JD Power asked 4,000 people about their financial health and found that 40% of them had turned to AI in the prior three months to help manage their finances.
sentences.zh: 数据分析公司 JD Power 向 4000 人询问了他们的财务健康，发现其中 40% 在过去三个月里曾求助于 AI 来管理财务。

sentences.en: More than a third of those using AI said they found the advice helpful in making smarter financial decisions.
sentences.zh: 使用 AI 的人中，超过三分之一表示这些建议有助于他们做出更明智的理财决策。

sentences.en: David Kendrick, a 53-year-old IT manager, uses ChatGPT so often for advice that he has started referring to it as "Chatty."
sentences.zh: 53 岁的 IT 经理 David Kendrick 如此频繁地用 ChatGPT 寻求建议，以至于他开始叫它“Chatty”。

sentences.en: He has asked it about everything from what to do with his home equity line of credit to how to handle his recent salary bump.
sentences.zh: 他向它咨询过各种各样的问题，从如何处理房屋净值信用额度，到如何安排最近涨的薪水。

sentences.en: Chatty suggested the Roth, and Kendrick listened.
sentences.zh: “Chatty”建议他选 Roth（个人退休账户），Kendrick 照做了。

sentences.en: Overall, Kendrick said, his finances are solid, but that's not necessarily true for the biggest group of people using AI for financial advice.
sentences.zh: Kendrick 说，总体而言他的财务状况稳健，但对使用 AI 理财建议的最大群体而言，情况未必如此。

sentences.en: A study found that AI does well at giving fairly broad economic advice, pushing people toward saving more and participating more in the stock market.
sentences.zh: 一项研究发现，AI 在给出相当宽泛的经济建议方面表现不错，会推动人们更多地储蓄、更多地参与股市。

sentences.en: But the AI didn't always give advice that lined up with what human financial experts would suggest, especially when dealing with more complicated requests.
sentences.zh: 但 AI 给出的建议并非总与人类理财专家的建议一致，尤其是在处理更复杂的请求时。

sentences.en: Finance experts think AI advice works best for people asking very basic questions or power users prepared to hand over lots of data.
sentences.zh: 理财专家认为，AI 建议对提出非常基础问题的人，或愿意提供大量数据的资深用户最有效。

sentences.en: AI models can make up sources — a phenomenon called "hallucination" — or make incorrect assumptions about someone's situation.
sentences.zh: AI 模型会编造来源——这种现象被称为“幻觉”——或对某人的情况做出错误假设。

vocab.zh: 增加；凸起（salary bump 涨薪）

grammar: 现在分词作结果状语：found that 40% ... had turned to AI ... to help manage 中 to help 不定式表目的，found 后接 that 宾语从句。
so...that 结果状语从句：uses ChatGPT so often for advice that he has started referring to it as "Chatty" 表示“如此频繁……以至于……”。
现在完成进行时：has started referring 强调从过去开始并持续的动作。
介词 from...to... 列举范围：from what to do with his home equity line of credit to how to handle his recent salary bump 列举咨询内容。
定语从句 that lined up with：advice that lined up with what human financial experts would suggest 中 that 引导定语从句修饰 advice。
并列连词 or 连接谓语：can make up sources — or make incorrect assumptions 中 or 连接两个动词短语。
过去分词作后置定语：a phenomenon called "hallucination" 中 called 过去分词修饰 phenomenon，意为“被称为……的现象”。

articles.title: How a road could change West Africa's urban future
articles.summary: 从尼日利亚拉各斯到科特迪瓦阿比让，一条沿海超级公路正串联西非城市走廊，既释放经济潜力，也暴露出贫困、检查站与城市扩张的难题。

sentences.en: A set of coastal interconnected cities between Lagos, Nigeria, and Abidjan, Ivory Coast, is expanding at an unprecedented rate.
sentences.zh: 从尼日利亚拉各斯到科特迪瓦阿比让，一连串沿海互联城市正以前所未有的速度扩张。

sentences.en: Africa is the world's youngest and fastest-growing continent.
sentences.zh: 非洲是世界上最年轻、增长最快的大陆。

sentences.en: By 2050, the Lagos-Abidjan region will be home to more than 50 million people.
sentences.zh: 到 2050 年，拉各斯—阿比让地区将容纳超过 5000 万人口。

sentences.en: For two weeks, NPR traveled along the Lagos-Abidjan corridor, documenting the pressures and possibilities reshaping everyday life.
sentences.zh: 在两周里，NPR 沿着拉各斯—阿比让走廊前行，记录着重塑日常生活的压力与可能。

sentences.en: The cities along the Atlantic coast are linked by a coastal road that is being gradually developed into a $15 billion superhighway.
sentences.zh: 大西洋沿岸的城市由一条沿海公路相连，这条公路正逐步被建设成一条耗资 150 亿美元的超级公路。

sentences.en: The project is led by ECOWAS, a regional bloc of 12 countries, and is intended to unlock the economic potential of the region.
sentences.zh: 该项目由西非国家经济共同体（一个 12 国区域集团）牵头，意在释放该地区的经济潜力。

sentences.en: Over the last decade, as Nigeria's economy faltered, the spending power that once fueled trade across the region weakened.
sentences.zh: 过去十年里，随着尼日利亚经济步履蹒跚，曾经推动跨区域贸易的购买力减弱了。

sentences.en: Along the way, NPR passed through more than 30 checkpoints over a less-than-10-mile stretch of the road.
sentences.zh: 沿途，NPR 在不到 10 英里的路段上经过了 30 多个检查站。

sentences.en: The pressures are pushing Accra's growing population to spread to the city's outskirts, where towns like Kasoa are now filling with residents escaping soaring rents.
sentences.zh: 压力正把阿克拉不断增长的人口推向城市边缘，像卡索阿这样的城镇如今挤满了为躲避飞涨房租而来的人。

sentences.en: A more affluent class of migrants is increasingly visiting and settling in Ghana, drawn by the glowing perception of Ghana as an African country on the rise.
sentences.zh: 更富裕的移民阶层正越来越多地造访并定居加纳，被加纳作为崛起中非洲国家的光鲜形象所吸引。

sentences.en: "These cities aren't delivering," said Hertzog. "They're not delivering in terms of infrastructure, educational opportunities, or security."
sentences.zh: “这些城市并没有兑现承诺，”Hertzog 说，“它们在基础设施、教育机会或安全方面都没有兑现。”

grammar: 现在分词作伴随/结果：documenting the pressures and possibilities reshaping everyday life 中 documenting 伴随 traveled，reshaping 现在分词修饰 pressures。
被动语态（现在进行时）：is being gradually developed into a $15 billion superhighway 用现在进行时的被动，表示“正被逐步建设成……”。
as 引导时间/原因状语从句：as Nigeria's economy faltered 中 as 表“随着”。
过去分词作后置定语：a regional bloc of 12 countries 中 of 短语修饰 bloc；residents escaping soaring rents 中 escaping 现在分词表主动。
定语从句 where 引导：where towns like Kasoa are now filling with residents 中 where 修饰 outskirts。
过去分词作定语：drawn by the glowing perception of Ghana 中 drawn 过去分词表被动“被……吸引”。
直接引语："These cities aren't delivering," said Hertzog 注意引语内用现在进行时 aren't delivering 表当前状态。

articles.title: Who really needs testosterone?
articles.summary: 社交媒体掀起“睾酮热”，但医生提醒：并非每个男性都需要补充睾酮，真正缺乏者才适合治疗，滥用可能影响生育并带来健康风险。

sentences.en: A few times, Dr. Jamin Brahmbhatt suspected he might have low testosterone, but when he checked his numbers, he discovered they were within a normal range.
sentences.zh: 有几次，Jamin Brahmbhatt 医生怀疑自己睾酮偏低，但当他检查数值时发现处于正常范围。

sentences.en: Social media is overflowing with testosterone content, from fears of "low T" to "T-maxxing" tutorials.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上充斥着关于睾酮的内容，从对“低 T”的担忧到“睾酮最大化”教程。

sentences.en: Brahmbhatt treats men with low testosterone every day and is on the front lines of the current cultural fixation with testosterone.
sentences.zh: Brahmbhatt 每天都为睾酮偏低的男性治疗，处在当下这种睾酮文化热潮的最前线。

sentences.en: "Not every guy needs to be on it," Brahmbhatt says, warning against men who get prescriptions online without testing.
sentences.zh: “并非每个男人都需要用，”Brahmbhatt 说，并警告那些未经检测就在网上拿到处方的人。

sentences.en: Testosterone is a sex hormone, but its effects on physiology extend well beyond reproduction.
sentences.zh: 睾酮是一种性激素，但它对生理的影响远远超出生殖范畴。

sentences.en: Symptoms of testosterone deficiency can easily be attributed to other causes, including depressed mood, fatigue, reduced libido and weight gain.
sentences.zh: 睾酮缺乏的症状很容易被归咎于其他原因，包括情绪低落、疲劳、性欲减退和体重增加。

sentences.en: Under the FDA's current criteria, testosterone therapy is only approved for men whose low levels can be traced to an identifiable medical condition.
sentences.zh: 根据 FDA 现行标准，睾酮疗法仅批准用于那些低水平可追溯到明确病症的男性。

sentences.en: The Trump administration has signaled it wants to revise that so men with low testosterone can qualify for treatment if they have low libido as a symptom.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府已表示希望修改该规定，使低睾酮男性若以性欲低下为症状也能获得治疗。

sentences.en: A major safety study known as TRAVERSE did not find an increased risk of heart attack or stroke when compared to placebo.
sentences.zh: 一项名为 TRAVERSE 的重大安全性研究未发现与安慰剂相比心脏病发作或中风风险增加。

sentences.en: The biggest downside, especially for younger men, is the impact on fertility, as testosterone therapy suppresses the body's production of sperm.
sentences.zh: 最大的弊端，尤其是对年轻男性而言，是对生育力的影响，因为睾酮疗法会抑制身体产生精子。

sentences.en: "Think of the 60-year-old guy who's got low testosterone... Go to the gym, man, go work out!" Bernie says, noting lifestyle changes can be an alternative.
sentences.zh: “想想那个 60 岁睾酮偏低的家伙……去健身房健身吧，”Bernie 说，并指出改变生活方式也是一种替代方案。

grammar: 并列连词 but 连接转折：suspected he might have low testosterone, but when he checked... 中 but 表转折，when 引导时间状语从句。
现在进行时表当前普遍状态：Social media is overflowing with... 描述正在持续的现象。
被动语态：is only approved for men whose low levels can be traced to... 中 approved / traced 均为过去分词表被动。
定语从句 whose 引导：men whose low levels can be traced to an identifiable medical condition 中 whose 指代 men，修饰 levels。
不定式作目的：to revise that / to qualify for treatment 中不定式表目的。
过去分词作后置定语：a major safety study known as TRAVERSE 中 known 过去分词修饰 study。
as 引导原因状语从句：as testosterone therapy suppresses the body's production of sperm 中 as 表“因为”。

articles.title: SpaceX's revenue rises as its once-soaring stock price drifts back to Earth
articles.summary: SpaceX 上市后首份季报营收近翻倍至 78 亿美元，但仍亏损 5.41 亿；股价从高点回落，市场对其 AI 重注与高估值分歧加大。

sentences.en: In its first quarterly report since offering shares to the public, Elon Musk's SpaceX announced soaring revenues and shrinking losses — but still not a profit.
sentences.zh: 在首次面向公众发行股票后的第一份季度报告中，马斯克的 SpaceX 公布了飙升的营收和收窄的亏损——但仍未盈利。

sentences.en: The company reported a near-doubling in revenue over the same quarter last year to $7.8 billion, beating expectations.
sentences.zh: 公司报告称营收较上年同期几乎翻倍，达到 78 亿美元，超出预期。

sentences.en: It logged a loss of $541 million as it poured money into its Starlink satellite network, spacecraft development and artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 由于大举投入 Starlink 卫星网络、航天器开发和人工智能，公司出现了 5.41 亿美元的亏损。

sentences.en: The company spent $18.4 billion in capital investments during the quarter.
sentences.zh: 该季度公司支出了 184 亿美元的资本投资。

sentences.en: Shares started trading at $150 and in mid-June shot to an intraday high of $225.64, but closed Tuesday at $125.33.
sentences.zh: 股价以 150 美元开盘，6 月中旬一度冲高至盘中 225.64 美元，但周二收于 125.33 美元。

sentences.en: More than $1 trillion has been erased from the company's market capitalization since the stock hit its mid-June peak.
sentences.zh: 自股价在 6 月中旬见顶以来，公司市值已蒸发超过 1 万亿美元。

sentences.en: Selling pressure could mount this week as a so-called "lockup" expires on Thursday, allowing insiders to sell shares.
sentences.zh: 本周抛售压力可能加大，因为周四一项“锁定期”将到期，允许内部人士出售股票。

sentences.en: Musk has said he wants to send people to the moon and Mars, and earlier this year SpaceX acquired xAI, his AI startup.
sentences.zh: 马斯克曾说想送人上月球和火星，今年早些时候 SpaceX 收购了他的 AI 初创公司 xAI。

sentences.en: "Maybe more than any IPO ever, the SpaceX IPO was about hopes and dreams and not the nuts and bolts of the business," said one analyst.
sentences.zh: “也许比以往任何 IPO 都更甚，SpaceX 的 IPO 关乎希望与梦想，而非生意的细枝末节，”一位分析师说。

sentences.en: The initial rise in the stock price was buoyed by retail investors who support Musk's vision.
sentences.zh: 股价的初始上涨得到了支持马斯克愿景的散户投资者的支撑。

sentences.en: Eventually gravity will tug shares downward if they are deemed overvalued, even for companies with sweeping plans.
sentences.zh: 如果股价被视为估值过高，终究重力会把股价拉低，即便是对那些有着宏大计划的公司也是如此。

grammar: 现在分词作结果状语：beating expectations 中 beating 现在分词作结果状语，表示“超出预期”。
since 引导时间状语从句（现在完成时）：More than $1 trillion has been erased ... since the stock hit its mid-June peak 用现在完成时 + since。
as 引导原因状语从句：as it poured money into... / as a so-called "lockup" expires 中 as 表“因为/随着”。
定语从句 who 引导：retail investors who support Musk's vision 中 who 修饰 investors。
被动语态：if they are deemed overvalued 中 deemed 过去分词表被动“被视为”。
破折号表转折补充：announced soaring revenues and shrinking losses — but still not a profit 中破折号引出反差。
过去分词作后置定语：a loss of $541 million ... 整体作 logged 的宾语；the stock hit its mid-June peak 用一般过去时。

articles.title: Nuclear power push ramps up uranium mill — and tribal health concerns
articles.summary: 美国推动复兴国内铀生产，犹他州 White Mesa 铀矿加工厂生意回暖，但周边原住民部落担忧放射性污染威胁饮水与健康。

sentences.en: On a hot April day, Malcolm Lehi maneuvered his Jeep Wrangler over a rough dirt road in search of Entrance Spring on land long connected to his tribe.
sentences.zh: 在四月一个炎热的日子，Malcolm Lehi 驾驶吉普牧马人碾过崎岖的土路，去寻找与他部落世代相连的土地上的 Entrance Spring。

sentences.en: The cool, mossy spring lies just across the highway from White Mesa Mill, the nation's only remaining conventional uranium mill.
sentences.zh: 清凉长满青苔的泉眼就位于公路对面，紧邻 White Mesa Mill——美国仅存的传统铀矿加工厂。

sentences.en: For decades, the mill has sparked debate over whether radioactive contamination threatens human health by getting into the water and the air.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这座工厂一直引发争论：放射性污染是否会通过水和空气危害人类健康。

sentences.en: Concerns run especially deep in the White Mesa Ute Community, where about 200 members of his tribe live five miles south of the facility.
sentences.zh: 在 White Mesa Ute 社区，担忧尤为深切，约 200 名部落成员住在工厂以南五英里处。

sentences.en: Now the tribe's concerns have taken on new urgency as the U.S. pushes to revive domestic uranium production.
sentences.zh: 如今，随着美国推动复兴国内铀生产，部落的担忧变得更加紧迫。

sentences.en: A federal law passed in 2024 bans imports of Russian uranium by 2028, increasing pressure to develop domestic fuel supplies.
sentences.zh: 2024 年通过的一项联邦法律禁止在 2028 年前进口俄罗斯铀，加大了开发国内燃料供应的压力。

sentences.en: President Trump set a goal to quadruple U.S. nuclear energy capacity by 2050 and issued orders to prioritize mining on federal lands.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统设定了到 2050 年将美国核能装机容量翻两番的目标，并下令优先在联邦土地上采矿。

sentences.en: Many tribal members won't drink the local water, relying on bottled water instead, aware of uranium's deadly legacy across the Colorado Plateau.
sentences.zh: 许多部落成员不喝当地的水，而是依赖瓶装水，因为他们清楚铀在科罗拉多高原留下的致命遗产。

sentences.en: "Water is life," Lehi said, "because that's where we all began."
sentences.zh: “水就是生命，”Lehi 说，“因为我们都是从那里开始的。”

sentences.en: A 2023 federal health assessment concluded that radiation levels measured at the tribe's air monitor were unlikely to harm human health.
sentences.zh: 2023 年的一项联邦健康评估得出结论：在部落空气监测器测得的辐射水平不太可能危害人类健康。

sentences.en: What's not in dispute is that the mill produces radioactive waste — and once that exists, it can linger for tens of thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 毫无争议的是，这座工厂会产生放射性废料——而一旦产生，它可能存在数万年之久。

grammar: 过去分词作后置定语：on land long connected to his tribe 中 connected 过去分词修饰 land。
介词 over + whether 宾语从句：debate over whether radioactive contamination threatens... 中 whether 引导宾语从句。
关系副词 where 引导定语从句：the White Mesa Ute Community, where about 200 members... live 中 where 修饰 community。
as 引导时间/原因状语从句：as the U.S. pushes to revive domestic uranium production 中 as 表“随着”。
现在分词作伴随状语：relying on bottled water instead 中 relying 现在分词表示伴随“转而依赖”。
名词性从句 what 引导主语从句：What's not in dispute is that the mill produces radioactive waste 中 What 引导主语从句。
过去分词作定语：A 2023 federal health assessment concluded that... 整体；measured at the tribe's air monitor 中 measured 过去分词修饰 levels。

articles.title: Science reporter on how evidence-based reporting can be a parent's best friend
articles.summary: NPR 记者 Maria Godoy 分享如何用循证思维拨开育儿噪音：每天户外两小时有助防近视，疫苗与自闭症的旧说法早已被研究驳倒。

sentences.en: NPR's Rob Schmitz talks to reporter Maria Godoy about how parents can wade through the noise and opinions to find information to keep their kids healthy.
sentences.zh: NPR 的 Rob Schmitz 与记者 Maria Godoy 探讨父母如何拨开噪音与各种观点，找到让孩子保持健康的信息。

sentences.en: Godoy says that when she became a parent, she was a bundle of nerves facing a near constant stream of advice.
sentences.zh: Godoy 说，当她初为人母时，面对几乎源源不断的建议，成了一团紧张的神经。

sentences.en: She often returns to a central question: how can parents make decisions based on the best available evidence without feeling overwhelmed?
sentences.zh: 她经常回到一个核心问题：父母如何在不感到不堪重负的情况下，基于现有最佳证据做决定？

sentences.en: There's a strong tie between exposure to being outdoors and sunlight and a lower risk of nearsightedness in children.
sentences.zh: 接触户外与阳光，和儿童较低的近视风险之间，存在很强的关联。

sentences.en: Research shows spending two hours a day outdoors can help prevent children from becoming nearsighted.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，每天在户外待两小时有助于预防儿童近视。

sentences.en: Godoy says parents today are bombarded with health advice from social media influencers and other sources.
sentences.zh: Godoy 说，如今的父母被来自社交媒体网红和其他渠道的健康建议狂轰滥炸。

sentences.en: She asks herself what information parents actually need versus just filtering out the noise.
sentences.zh: 她问自己，父母真正需要什么信息，而不是仅仅过滤掉噪音。

sentences.en: Claims linking vaccines to autism stem from a 1998 study that has been thoroughly debunked by a large body of research.
sentences.zh: 把疫苗与自闭症联系起来的说法，源自一项 1998 年的研究，而该研究已被大量研究彻底驳倒。

sentences.en: Godoy tries to start from the perspective that every parent wants what's best for their child.
sentences.zh: Godoy 力求从“每位父母都想给孩子最好的”这一视角出发。

sentences.en: "They're just doing the best they can with the information they have," she says of hesitant parents.
sentences.zh: “他们只是用自己掌握的信息尽力而为，”她在谈到犹豫的父母时说。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, Godoy hopes parents take away that they should give themselves grace.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，Godoy 希望父母记住：要对自己宽容一些。

vocab.zh: 被密集炮轰的；应接不暇的

grammar: 疑问词 + 不定式：how parents can wade through... 与 how can parents make decisions 中 how 引导从句，作介词 about / 动词 return to 的宾语。
现在分词作伴随状语：facing a near constant stream of advice 中 facing 现在分词作伴随，a bundle of nerves 为比喻。
过去分词作后置定语：a 1998 study that has been thoroughly debunked 中 debunked 过去分词表被动完成。
现在完成时：has been thoroughly debunked by a large body of research 强调对现在的影响。
定语从句 that 引导：a 1998 study that has been thoroughly debunked 中 that 修饰 study。
介词 versus 表对比：what information parents actually need versus just filtering out the noise 中 versus 表“与……相对”。
同位语从句：the perspective that every parent wants what's best for their child 中 that 引导同位语从句，解释 perspective。

articles.title: NVIDIA is about to spend $750 billion on AI. Critics are calling it a bubble
articles.summary: 英伟达据报拟投 7500 亿美元建数据中心， critics 担心“循环融资”吹大 AI 泡沫；分析师提醒，AI 真实但赢家未必是当下领跑者。

sentences.en: Seven hundred and fifty billion dollars — that's what Nvidia is thinking of spending on data centers to strengthen its supply chain.
sentences.zh: 7500 亿美元——这正是英伟达考虑在数据中心上投入以强化其供应链的金额。

sentences.en: Nvidia is the largest chipmaker by far, and its graphics chips have become the workhorse chip in the AI space.
sentences.zh: 英伟达是目前最大的芯片制造商，其图形芯片已成为人工智能领域的主力芯片。

sentences.en: In the past month alone, Nvidia has unveiled a partnership with South Korean conglomerate SK Group worth more than $500 billion.
sentences.zh: 仅过去一个月，英伟达就公布了与韩国企业集团 SK Group 一项价值超 5000 亿美元的合作关系。

sentences.en: Critics are calling the situation "circular financing," where a company gives another company money to buy its product.
sentences.zh: 批评者称这种情况为“循环融资”——即一家公司给另一家公司钱去买自己的产品。

sentences.en: There's also concern that any impairment to one company risks spreading a contagion throughout the whole ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 还有人担忧，任何一家公司的受损都可能将危机扩散至整个生态系统。

sentences.en: In a nutshell, the question becomes: if the music stops on the AI expansion, who ends up left holding the bag?
sentences.zh: 简而言之，问题变成了：如果 AI 扩张的音乐停下，谁会落得两手空空？

sentences.en: Jensen Huang hates the term circular financing and argues they are investing, not literally funding their own sales.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋讨厌“循环融资”这个词，并辩称他们是在投资，而非字面上为自己的销售融资。

sentences.en: Bass covered the dotcom bubble early in her career and notes that many ideas from that era ended up being right.
sentences.zh: Bass 在职业生涯早期报道过互联网泡沫，并指出那个时代许多想法最终被证明是对的。

sentences.en: But the companies behind those ideas did not always end up being the ones that led the way.
sentences.zh: 但那些想法背后的公司，并不总是一路领先的公司。

sentences.en: People in the space will tell you AI is real and these are legitimate, important technologies.
sentences.zh: 业内人会告诉你，AI 是真实的，这些是重要的技术。

sentences.en: That doesn't necessarily translate into the notion that the companies currently leading will be the ones benefiting five or 10 years from now.
sentences.zh: 这并不必然意味着当前领先的公司在五到十年后会成为受益者。

vocab.zh: 图形的（graphics chips 图形芯片）
循环的（circular financing 循环融资）

grammar: 破折号 + that's what 强调句：Seven hundred and fifty billion dollars — that's what Nvidia is thinking of spending... 用 that's what 强调金额。
现在完成时：has unveiled a partnership / has become 表示过去动作对现在的影响。
定语从句 where 引导：a situation "circular financing," where a company gives... 中 where 修饰 situation。
条件状语从句 if：if the music stops on the AI expansion, who ends up left holding the bag? 中 if 引导条件。
现在分词作定语：the companies currently leading 中 leading 现在分词修饰 companies。
并列连词 and 连接谓语：hates the term ... and argues they are investing 中 and 连接两个谓语。
同位语从句：the notion that the companies currently leading will be the ones... 中 that 引导同位语从句，解释 notion。
